body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> iLuv presented its 8.5-inch portable multimedia player 'i1155' during CES 2009, which is designed for your iPod and DVD.
Adopting a touch keypad and a built-in iPod docking station, the i1155 is equipped with S-Video slot, a built-in battery pack and a car cigar jack charger.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
